title: Enterprise Dedicated: Compatibility Matrix + SLA Migration Checker for Compliance-Constrained Intakes
creator: Nora Patel
description:
Goal:
Create a deterministic intake artifact (compatibility matrix + automated SLA migration checker) to evaluate enterprise dedicated capacity requests that carry compliance constraints (KMS/FIPS/HSM, VPC-only, air-gapped) and mixed-GPU families. The artifact should produce a clear recommended reservation plan (GPU class, reserved throughput, burst policy, phased scaling) and surface migration risk when customers later change SLA or require model upgrades.

Background:
We repeatedly see long negotiation cycles for enterprise reserved capacity when customers have compliance guardrails (customers requiring FIPS 140-2 or customer-managed KMS, or on-prem/air-gapped requirements) combined with heterogeneous model fleets. Sales and solutions engineering waste time recalculating throughput and fallback ladders when customers switch models or tighten SLAs. Engineering teams are also conservative about GPU family mappings due to kernel/quantization differences.

Success criteria:
- Intake returns a deterministic recommended reservation plan with predicted p95 latency and cost delta compared to hosted baseline (for the requested model families).
- Provides a migration-risk score (0-100) indicating how painful it will be to maintain SLA after model/quantization/sequence-length changes.
- Produces a compact preflight checklist for compliance constraints and a one-click set of follow-ups for solutions engineers.
- Reduces avg. negotiation time for compliance-heavy deals from ~18 days to <7 days (measure in Ops logs).

Scope and components:
1) Compatibility matrix (CSV+UI view): map model variants -> supported GPU families -> required runtime knobs (quantization profile, kernel variants) -> known caveats (KV cache warm-up behavior, max seq differences).
2) SLA Migration Checker (automated runner): given customer inputs (target p50/p95, request rate, session length distribution, compliance flags), simulate reservation outcomes across candidate GPU families and reserved throughput profiles, and output: recommended pool, recommended burst window, fallback ladder, and migration-risk score.
3) Compliance preflight checklist: KMS/FIPS status, audit log retention, network topology constraints, image signing requirements, and package whitelist for on-prem.
4) Intake template + generated artifact to attach to Linear ticket and to seed onboarding playbook for Dedicated onboarding team.

Constraints & trade-offs:
- We cannot perfectly model new kernels/quantization modes before onboarding; migration-risk will use historical deltas + conservative heuristics.
- For air-gapped/on-prem, we will require manual validation steps (out of scope for automation).
- Tight SLAs with mixed-GPU fleets will recommend single-GPU-family reservations unless cost delta > X% (configurable).

Out of scope:
- Full automated provisioning of dedicated pools. (This ticket only produces the intake artifacts and recommendations.)

2026-02-18 - PM review: Pull request opened for PM doc updates. Request feedback from Solutions Eng to add customer-facing phrasing for the generated artifact.
decisions: Decision 2026-01-30: Include kernel-compatibility risk in migration score; metric will be a weighted sum: perf-delta-history (50%), kernel-compat (30%), compliance-friction (20%).
Decision 2026-02-05: For intake UX, produce both a one-page executive summary (customer-facing) and a detailed technical appendix (for Eng/SE).
Decision 2026-02-12: Pilot will target up to 3 GPU families (A100x, H100q, L4x) and allow matches only when predicted cost delta < 20% or migration-risk < 40.

notes_for_SE: When running the intake, collect a small representative request trace (5-10m) and an expected growth curve. For on-prem/air-gapped customers include their package whitelist and signing process; these are common blockers.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Compatibility matrix prototype uploaded and validated with two pilot customers.
2) SLA Migration Checker returns deterministic recommendations for given inputs and produces migration-risk score.
3) Intake artifact templates (customer one-pager + technical appendix) reviewed by Solutions Eng and Security.
4) Reduction in avg negotiation time for pilot customers measured in dashboard.
